tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search current Spanish court auctions (BOE section IV) and State/public-body sales (BOE section V-B). Use it first to find listings by province, town, type, asset type, starting price or dates; then call get_listing with an id for the full record. Returns total count, paging (limit/offset) and short

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full record for one listing by id from search_listings (SUB-… for court auctions, BOE-B-… for State sales from the BOE, TGSS-… for Social Security (TGSS) auctions): lots with starting price and deposit, bid deadline, auction session date, bidding mode, approximate place, HammerMap's general risk ana

tools.name: get_facets
tools.description: Counts of current listings by type, procedure, asset type and province, the starting-price range, covered countries, and data freshness (data_updated, latest_boe_publication, update_frequency). Use it to discover valid filter values for search_listings or to answer "how many / how fresh" questions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_listing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full record for one listing by id from search_listings (SUB-… for court auctions, BOE-B-… for State sales): lots with starting price and deposit, bid deadline, auction session date, bidding mode, approximate place, HammerMap's general risk analysis with legal basis (not legal advice), corrections, o" → after: "Full record for one listing by id from search_listings (SUB-… for court auctions, BOE-B-… for State sales from the BOE, TGSS-… for Social Security (TGSS) auctions): lots with starting price and deposit, bid deadline, auction session date, bidding mode, approximate place, HammerMap's general risk ana"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
